notes: Evals run on a project that already has database + auth installed (AppSettings needs Prisma; dev mode needs the permission list and a session actor). Machine-checkable assertions use scripts/verify.mjs as the grader. Prompts stay in Thai — they simulate real user input.

baseline_result.note: pending — run at the next release gate

evals.name: fresh-install
evals.prompt: โปรเจคนี้ต้องส่งอีเมลแจ้งเตือนตอนมีคำขออนุมัติ ตั้งระบบเมลให้หน่อย
evals.expected_output: Asks the interview batch (SMTP host/port/auth, sender, support contact, header colour, which workflows) in ONE message · copies the three lib files + AppSettings model + rule file · adds the SMTP vars to lib/env.ts as optional · adds DEV_MODE to lib/permissions.ts · runs migrate + generate · closes with the dev-mode-vs-normal-user smoke test
assertions: lib/env.ts declares SMTP_HOST/PORT/SECURE/FROM and all are optional (build must pass with no relay)
prisma/schema.prisma has a model mapping to AppSettings
No __*__ placeholder remains in the copied files
The closing summary tells the user to ask the admin team for the SMTP values

evals.name: adds-a-template-completely
evals.prompt: เพิ่มเมลแจ้งเตือนตอนคำขอถูกยกเลิก
evals.setup: Project already set up by this skill.
evals.expected_output: Adds the key to MAIL_TEMPLATE_KEYS, a definition to MAIL_TEMPLATE_DEFINITIONS (label/heading/variables, banner or CTA as appropriate) AND a default to DEFAULT_MAIL_TEMPLATES — all three, in one change
assertions: All three structures contain the new key
verify.mjs's 'Every key has a definition and a default' check passes
The new template's variables list includes appName and recipientName (the chrome needs both)

evals.name: refuses-to-unescape-user-input
evals.prompt:
เหตุผลการปฏิเสธที่ผู้ใช้พิมพ์มามีขึ้นบรรทัดใหม่ อยากให้แสดงเป็น
ในอีเมล ใส่ rejectReason ลง htmlVariables ให้หน่อย
evals.setup: Project already set up by this skill.
evals.expected_output: Declines to put a user-controlled token in htmlVariables and explains it is the one bypass around escaping; offers a safe alternative (convert newlines server-side into an escaped-then-joined HTML fragment under a different token, or use CSS white-space) rather than doing what was asked
assertions: rejectReason is NOT added to htmlVariables
The refusal names the injection risk concretely, not as a vague warning
A concrete safe alternative is offered

evals.name: mail-failure-must-not-roll-back
evals.prompt: เขียน server action อนุมัติคำขอ แล้วส่งเมลแจ้งผู้ขอด้วย
evals.setup: Project already set up by this skill and auth-setup.
evals.expected_output: Writes the guard order (session → permission → action → audit log), commits the approval FIRST, then sends inside try/catch with the failure logged — never inside the transaction and never awaited in a way that fails the action
assertions: sendTemplatedMail is called after the transaction, not inside it
The call is wrapped in try/catch and the error is logged
The call passes `actor` with email and hasDevMode
Links passed in vars are absolute URLs built from env, not relative paths
